events.body:
## Context

`src/pages/submit.html:139` imports `https://unpkg.com/@zip.js/zip.js/index.js` with no version, so every reporter's browser loads whatever was published last, on the page that builds the encrypted ZIP.

## What to do

1. Pin an exact current version in the URL and note in the README how to bump it. Don't change the encryption code.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] URL has an exact version
- [ ] A submission with a screenshot still produces a ZIP that 7-Zip opens

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-zero && npx wrangler dev
```

---
